_why: P3036c (25/10/2026 Paris): single source of the publish Zigbee caps. Read by scripts/lib/publish-caps.cjs (prepare-publish, platform budget gate, z2m-coverage, tests, workflows). Change a cap here only; the publish workflows no longer set HOMEY_ZIGBEE_* caps (an env var with that name still overrides for a manual run). P3041 (owner yes t526s3030, 25/10/2026 18:32 Paris): back to the measured-safe caps (17000 base, 1008 per driver, top-ups 20000/1008, allowAboveMeasuredCombos 0) = what Athom has actually accepted (20000 total, 1008 per driver). caseFormsNeedSource 1 = an all-lower/all-upper case form with no external source gets no compaction/top-up room. pruneArtifactCaseForms 1 = such a form is also removed when it was pinned, but only when the same driver keeps a sourced or mixed-case form of the same manufacturer with the same productIds; the P3024b gate then counts that couple as kept case-insensitively (caseEquivalent) and still fails on any couple lost case-insensitively. The removed list is written next to the payload (p3041-case-prune.json).

measured.rejectedForSize: P2252 at 100k+ raw combos; the October AggregateErrors (9.0.1365, 9.0.1426) were not combo related (9.0.1364 accepted with the same payload)

decision.rule: Measured-safe caps (P3036d rollback values) with the artifact case twin prune ON: no driver above 1008 combos, total <= 20000 (accepted), every baseline couple kept case-insensitively on its driver with its sourced/canonical form. Upload app.json cap 3537000 B unchanged.

rollback.when: a real device is seen reporting a pruned all-lower/all-upper form, or the owner reverts
rollback.how: set pruneArtifactCaseForms 0 here (the exact P3024b gate comes back, same safe caps); to go back to the P3036d raised caps restore decision.previous.caps

previous.rule: The real bound is the uploaded app.json size: cap = 90 % of the largest accepted (3.93 MB, 9.0.1520) = 3537000 bytes, checked on the final upload. Combos: 20000 accepted, only rejection at 100k+; top-ups up to 45000 (< 90 % of 100k), per driver 2000 (caps of the accepted 9.0.664/698). Every addition is an exact mfr+pid couple a source compose declares (owner t524u).
